text: Animation is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates artistic creativity, technical implementation and narrative expression, conveying stories, emotions and ideas through dynamic image language. The core of it is to convert static images into continuous images, involving various forms such as 2D animation, 3D animation, stop-motion animation, and digital special effects, and is widely used in fields such as film and television, games, advertising, education, and virtual reality. Unlike pure fine arts, animation places more emphasis on narrative logic and movement laws, and it is a compound major of "art + technology"
